concept: SQS: dead-letter queue for poison messages
tests: How to isolate malformed SQS messages that keep crashing the consumer and blocking the queue.
expected: Dead-letter queue with maxReceiveCount in the redrive policy — after N failed attempts the message moves to the DLQ for analysis. Triggers: "malformed message", "fail repeatedly", "isolate messages".
why_not: Raising the visibility timeout only delays redelivery; FIFO changes ordering semantics; long polling reduces empty responses but doesn't isolate messages.
